items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: She and I are very good friends, and I hear from her about every week or two.

ctx.x: That's where I first saw her. It was in about 1940 in New York.

That's when she went for the show. And she went to Paris, and she stayed there. Yes. Well, I've never seen her since. But she's back now. She's working at the hospital there in New York. Oh, really? She and I are very good friends, and I hear from her about every week or two. Yes. I hear from her. And every time she comes here, she comes here with me.
If you don't mind, tell me, where were you born? Right here in Chicago?

items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Between times I recorded with Lovie, Tommy Ladnier.

ctx.x: Before we go on to the '40's.

Now, wait. Let me get -- this says -- still in Chicago, before New York, I've got this down. Let me see. Between times I recorded with Lovie, Tommy Ladnier. Oh, I played the Regal Theater in Chicago -- Regal Theater, still in Chicago. I worked at Packy McFarland's After Hour Club, and there's when I went to the Burnham Inn. Got that?
